decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1/The proposed front extension, by reason of its size and position forward of the main building line, would be detrimental to the residential amenity of the neighbouring property, resulting in enclosure and loss of outlook, and would represent an incongruous and obtrusive feature detrimental to the character of the terrace and appearance of the streetscene, contrary to Adopted UDP policy ENV.1.1 and Revised Deposit (January 2001) policy ENV-B.1.1

Condition : 2 - 2/The proposed staircase and walkway to first floor flat, by reason of its height and position along the boundary, would be detrimental to the residential amenity of the neighbouring property, resulting in overlooking and loss of privacy, contrary to Adopted UDP policy ENV.1.1 and Revised Deposit (January 2001) policy ENV-B.1.1

Condition : 3 - 3/ The proposed garage by reason of its position in relation to the highway and proposed up-and-over door, would fail to provide sufficient visibility splays, and would open across the footpath, resulting in conditions prejudicial to the safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area, contrary to Adopted UDP policy T.2.5 and Revised Deposit (January 2001) policy T.1.4.
description: DEMOLITION OF GARAGE AND ERECTION OF A SINGLE-STOREY REAR EXTENSION, SINGLE-STOREY FRONT EXTENSION AND DETACHED SINGLE-STOREY GARAGE TO EXISTING SHOP
